## Featured Projects
- **AngaDrive V3** (`https://drive.anga.codes/`): Self-hosted cloud drive. Go + SolidJS + SQLite. RAM-first metadata cache, 7 MB chunked gzip-compressed uploads, WebSocket real-time state, cycle-safe collection graph, SHA-256 content-addressed storage.
- **Containerization API** (`https://compiler.anga.codes/`): Online compiler with a hand-built Linux sandbox. Go + Linux namespaces + cgroups v2 + seccomp-BPF + chroot. No Docker.
- **AngaOS**: 32-bit x86 hobby operating system from scratch. NASM + C, custom BIOS bootloader, GDT, protected-mode transition, direct VGA rendering.
- **PPT2PDF** (`https://ppt2pdf.anga.codes/`): Fault-tolerant PowerPoint-to-PDF converter. FastAPI + LibreOffice with speculative PPTX repair and fallback ladder.
- **LeetCode Tracker** (`https://battle.anga.codes/`): GitHub Actions as a scheduled backend. Java updater, Git as database, static React + Chart.js dashboard.
